{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Dud|more=Bolt}} {{Character |type=Athlete |image=[[File:Dud_Bolt_Podracer_Cockpit.png]] |name=Dud Bolt |homeworld=[[Vulpter]]''[[Star Wars Complete Vehicles, New Edition]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Vulptereen]]{{ForceCollection|Dud Bolt|star=1}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Yellow]]{{Film|I}} |skin=Blue-gray, yellow, white |cyber= |families= |parents=[[Dud's mom]][[Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset|''Star Wars: Beyond Victory'' - A Mixed Reality Playset]] |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Sebulba]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|And back again, it's the mighty Dud Bolt with that incredible racing machine, the Vulptereen 327!|Fodesinbeed Annodue introduces Dud Bolt at the Boonta Eve Classic|audio=Fode-DudBolt-TPM.flac|}} '''Dud Bolt''' was a [[Vulptereen]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Vulpter]] who worked as a [[podracer]] [[Podracer (profession)|pilot]] and [[Assassin|hitman]]. He [[Pilot|flew]] a [[Vulptereen 327]] and served as a mid-air [[bodyguard]] for the [[Dug]] [[Racer|podracer]] [[Sebulba]]. In [[32 BBY]], he [[Boonta Eve Classic Podracer pilot|participated]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] race on the planet [[Tatooine]]. Bolt was one of the favorites to win the [[Podracing|race]] but ended up crashing after a collision with fellow racer [[Ark Roose]] during the third lap. He survived the crash and was taken to a [[Mos Espa medcenter|medcenter]] in [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]]. Following the crash, Roose and Bolt developed a rivalry and Roose [[poison]]ed [[Dud's mom|Bolt's mother]] while trying to target him. The Vulptereen continued racing and in [[22 BBY]] took part in a race on the planet [[Ando Prime]], which was broadcast live to the [[Outlander Club]] on the planet [[Coruscant]]. ==Biography== ===On the starting grid=== {{Quote|I see the contestants are making their way out on to the starting grid.|Fodesinbeed Annodue commentating on Dud Bolt and the other podracers before the Boonta Eve Classic|audio=Fode-StartingGrid.flac|}} [[File:Vulptereen_327.png|thumb|left|250px|Dud Bolt flew a Vulptereen 327 during the Boonta Eve Classic.]] Dud Bolt was a [[Vulptereen]] [[Gender|male]] [[Assassin|hitman]]{{BuildFalconCite|36|Guide to the Galaxy}} from the [[planet]] [[Vulpter]] who flew as a [[podracer]] [[Podracer (profession)|pilot]] during the final [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. He used a [[Vulptereen 327]] racer from his [[homeworld]] and worked as the mid-air [[bodyguard]] of [[Sebulba]], a vicious [[Dug]] [[Racer|podracer]].''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' By [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]]. Bolt had [[Boonta Eve Classic Podracer pilot|participated]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] that took place [[Standard year|annually]] in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the planet [[Tatooine]]. That year, he and Sebulba both entered as one of the eighteen [[Pilot|competitors]],''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' with both the Vulptereen and Dug being among the favorites to win. [[Dud Bolt's Podracer|Bolt's vehicle]] was placed in the second row of the race's starting grid at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]], behind Sebulba, and prior to the start of the race, the Vulptereen sat in the [[cockpit]] of his vehicle while the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Mat Rags]]''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' worked on it. After the [[Troig]] commentators [[Fodesinbeed Annodue]] announced the racer as "the mighty Dud Bolt," members of the audience stood and cheered. Annodue also nicknamed the racer "the Great Dud Bolt." Following the introduction of the participants, each of their flags was carried in procession across the front of the racing grid, including Bolt's flag, which consisted of a thin [[Color|blue]] triangular flag above a thin dark gray triangular flag and then a large red rectangular flag below that. ===The race and further career=== {{Quote|Now those racers had some rivalries.''"
"''Oh, yeah. Nothing now like back in the day. I mean, Ark Roose and Dud Bolt after that crash during Boonta Eve a while ago? Ooowee! Legends.''"
"''They took it off the track.''"
"''Way off the track. Ark poisoned Dud's mom!''"
"''I heard.''"
"''Well, sh–she lived, she's ok. It was meant for Dud, but…|The host of ''Track Talk'' and Coy Vrizh|audio=DudBoltsMom-BeyondVictory.flac|}} [[File:Bolt_flag.svg|thumb|right|250px|Dud Bolt's flag]] Once the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] signaled for the race to begin, Bolt left the starting grid but quickly fell toward the back of the pack. He was managing to stay ahead of at least two other vehicles and was close behind the [[Nosaurian]] [[Clegg Holdfast]] when they were both overtaken prior to entering [[the Notch]] in the first lap by the [[human]] racer [[Anakin Skywalker]], who had stalled on the starting line. Bolt made it as far as the third lap but then crashed into the pilot [[Ark Roose]] in [[the Coil]] portion of the [[Mos Espa podrace circuit|track]] shortly before Sebulba crashed on the [[Hutt Flats]]. Skywalker ultimately won the race, while Bolt ended up in a [[Mos Espa medcenter]] following his crash. Following the crash, Bolt and Roose developed a rivalry that extended off the track. Roose tried to [[poison]] Bolt but instead ended up poisoning the [[Dud's mom|Vulptereen's mother]]. She survived the incident and recovered. Despite the loss, Bolt continued to compete in races across [[the galaxy]] and in [[22 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, which includes the race on [[Ando Prime]] being broadcast live, to [[22 BBY]]. participated in a race on the planet [[Ando Prime]] using his Vulptereen 327. Footage of the race was playing{{Film|II}} live via the [[HoloNet]] in the [[Outlander Club]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] when Skywalker, who had since become a [[Jedi]], and his master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], entered the club. [[File:Ark_Roose_Waving_like_a_Champ.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Ark Roose waves to the crowd in the Mos Espa Grand Arena during the Boonta Eve Classic.|Dud Bolt developed a rivalry with Ark Roose after their crash.]] Around [[10 BBY]],{{BeyondVictoryDate}} the [[Snivvian]] podracer [[Coy Vrizh]] discussed Bolt and Roose's rivalry, including the poisoning of Bolt's [[Parent|mother]], with the [[Radio DJ|host]] of the [[Subspace transceiver|radio]] show ''[[Track Talk]]'' during an [[In the Pits|interview]], calling the pair legends and expressing that there were no longer rivalries like that in the sport. A mention of Bolt was included on a poster for the Boonta Eve Classic in the Tatooine section of the [[book]] ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', [[author]]ed by the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[RA-7 protocol droid|protocol droid]] [[DK-RA-43]] at some point after the [[Battle of Crait]]''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' in [[34 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' At some point after [[35 ABY]], Bolt was mentioned as one of the notable entrants to the Boonta Eve Classic in a [[Unidentified historical book|book]] detailing objects from throughout [[Timeline of galactic history|galactic history]].''[[Star Wars 100 Objects]]'' ==Personality and traits== Dud Bolt was a short [[alien]] with the fast reflexes one needed in order to be successful in a sport such as podracing. He was a predatory pilot and had bluish-gray skin and yellow [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Dud Bolt piloted a celebrated Vulptereen 327 podracer, a vehicle that Fodesinbeed Annodue described as an "incredible racing machine." Bolt's [[podracer engine]]s were predominantly red, with the front of the [[engine]]s being silver and the back ends being blue. Bolt's cockpit was blue with red glyphs painted on the side. While racing, he wore brown [[leather]] [[armor]] with [[goggles]] built into the [[helmet]]. ==Behind the scenes== ===Design and name=== [[File:Dud_Bolt_Concept.png|thumb|left|250px|Anatomical concept art for Dud Bolt was drawn by Terryl Whitlatch on May 30, 1996.]] Dud Bolt was created for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] drew anatomical concept art of the character on [[May 30]], [[1996]], and two costume concepts were then drawn with one labeled [[September 12]], 1996 and the other drawn by [[Jay Shuster]]. A full maquette of the character was also produced based on Witlatch's sketch.{{InsiderCite|224|The Star Wars Archive|The ''Star Wars'' Archive}} All of the podracing aliens were designed to have some sort of evolutionary advantage in high speed racing, with Bolt's being the sensitive [[antenna]] on his snout.{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Complete Saga|featurette=Episode I: Tatooine|nolink=1}} Bolt's name is a play on the word "[[Wikipedia:Dead bolt|deadbolt]]."{{SW|url=news/25-weird-star-wars-character-names|text=25 Wonderfully Weird ''Star Wars'' Character Names}} In the revised rough draft of the film, he was instead named "Dud Cullindaros of Chuba,"[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']] and the names "[[Bozzie Barada]]" and "[[Bozzie Baranta]]" were also used for the character at one point in production,''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'' including on concept art. The name Bozzie Barada was still erroneously used for a podracer in the film's 1999 [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Terry Brooks]],[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]] while Bozzie Baranta was developed into a separate character in the 1999 [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer]]''.[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] ===Puppet=== {{Quote|With the Dud Bolt puppet, it was nice, because it was actually a practical puppet that we did.|Danny Wagner|audio=Wagner-DudBolt.flac|}} [[File:DudBoltPuppet.png|thumb|right|250px|Dud Bolt was controlled as a hand puppet on set.]] Model maker [[Danny Wagner]] produced a hand puppet of Bolt consisting of only the character's torso, head, and [[Limb|arms]]. It was molded and cast in latex, likely with elements of foam latex, and then had cheesecloth added for strength. Once it was cured, polyfilla was added, and the puppet was then dressed in a costume made of vaccu-formed pieces covered in dyed leather and greebles. Green sticks protruding from the back of the puppet's elbows were used as puppeteering rods to control it during filming. A Model Build/Shoot Gantt chart for the film dated [[February 27]], [[1998]] listed a full puppet of Bolt as needed for shooting between [[April 12]] and [[May 10]] of that year, with a note that the shoot might take place in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]].''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]'' Wagner and [[Mark Siegel]] controlled the puppet on set and spent about a day shooting with visual effects supervisor [[John Knoll]], although only a few seconds of footage made it into the film. Bolt was one of only two podracers rendered as a physical puppet rather than only computer graphics, although for distant shots of his vehicle he was also digitally rendered.{{DB|character|dudbolt|Bolt, Dud}} The puppet is included in the touring [[Star Wars Identities: The Exhibition|''Star Wars'' Identities]] exhibition.{{SW|url=news/character-building-at-star-wars-identities-in-paris|text=Character Building at ''Star Wars'' Identities|nolive=1}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *{{Film|II}} {{C|[[Podracer]] only}} *[[Star Wars: Beyond Victory -
